finding: all self-model errors in this instrument are optimistic: the geometric estimate is a subset of the truth, and a wrong cell count DROPS a cell rather than merging them. An observer believes it is less blind than it is, never more; the structural-prior error costs 1 of 4 task events.
limits: two cells, disjoint, ordered along x, one lane band, noise-free; n_cells is supplied rather than estimated
